extractedWith: tools/extract/extract.ps1 -Batch p5-portal -Manifest <scratch copy of allowlist.manifest.yaml with the p5-portal batch> -Clean (staging %TEMP%/codelab-extract/p5-portal, outside the repo; scrub findings are expected before the rewrite; secret scan clean)
promotion: Each staged file was read as a reference and rewritten with starter names and structure; "target" is the repo file it informed, "stagedTarget" the path in the staging folder. Content is a rewrite, so the repo file hash differs from stagedSha256. No source-product wording or inbox addresses were carried.

origins.note: Rewritten as SubmitContactMessage, ContactFiling and ContactAnnouncer: trimmed values, the validator owns the field rules (codes, not sentences), an inactive topic is a field error, the number comes from the kernel SQL-sequence allocator (CU prefix) instead of a redraw loop, and the inbox is announced after the save through INotificationService with a load-bearing catch. Left behind: first and last name fields, the session user attribution and the inquiry-type list.
Rewritten as the module ports IContactMessageStore and IContactTopics (topics come from the contact-topics lookup).
Rewritten as SubmitContactMessageCommand (fullName, email, topicId, message, language; all nullable so missing fields are field errors) and ContactReceiptResponse (only the number is echoed).

Rewritten as PortalContactController: anonymous, the per-client rate-limit policy (trusted-proxy aware) instead of a separate policy, whole-request signature exemption, 201 through PortalResults. The anonymous inquiry-type endpoint was not carried (topics are lookup data).
Patterns only: attribute checks (anonymous, rate-limited, signature-exempt) and the 201 mapping.
Patterns only: validation per field, trimming, inactive topic refused, number allocated and stored before the notification, notification failure keeps the receipt.
Patterns only: the anonymous write carries the rate-limit policy; the 429 behaviour itself is covered by the kernel rate limiter and the contract test AllAnonymousWritesAreRateLimited.
